title: HWholesome Oven-Roasted Pork Kebabs Bake
description: A savory and comforting Kenyan dish featuring pork tenderloin, baked to perfection with a crunchy exterior.
instructions: Mix onion, garlic, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Cube the pork tenderloin and place it in a mixing bowl with the spice mixture. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Place marinated pork on skewers (four pieces) and brush each piece lightly with oil before placing them in an oven-safe dish.
Bake for 25 minutes or until pork is fully cooked, flipping once halfway through baking time to ensure even cooking.
Remove from the oven and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
